Q. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Women Cancer Screening Advanced Package?
Ans.
The Thyrocare Women Cancer Screening Advanced Package includes 36 specialized tests designed to detect early signs of multiple cancers in women. This includes tumor markers such as CA-125, CA 15.3, CA 19.9, Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA), Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP), Beta hCG along with a Complete Blood Count (CBC). These tests help assess risk for cancers like ovarian, breast, cervical, uterine, liver, thyroid, and gastrointestinal tract cancers. All samples are processed using advanced diagnostic technology in Thyrocare’s NABL and ISO-certified laboratories.
Q. Can this package replace a regular gynecological checkup or imaging like mammography or ultrasound?
Ans.
No, this package is meant to complement, not replace, regular gynecological exams or imaging procedures like mammograms or pelvic ultrasounds. While blood tests can screen for certain cancer markers, comprehensive cancer screening may require a combination of clinical examination, imaging, and pathology depending on your doctors recommendation.
Q. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Women Cancer Screening Advanced test?
Ans.
This package is ideal for women aged 35 and above or those with a family history of cancer, hormonal issues, or symptoms such as persistent fatigue, unexplained weight changes, pelvic pain, or irregular menstrual cycles. It is also highly recommended for women who want to proactively monitor their health and screen for potential malignancies at an early stage.
Q. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Women Cancer Screening Advanced test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting for a period of 10 to 12 hours is necessary before the sample collection. Only water is allowed during the fasting window to ensure that test results, especially tumor markers and blood counts, are accurate and reliable.
Q. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare Women Cancer Screening test?
Ans.
Thyrocare offers convenient home sample collection services. A trained phlebotomist will visit your home at a scheduled time to collect a blood sample. The sample is then transported under controlled conditions to Thyrocare’s fully automated diagnostic laboratories, which are accredited by NABL and ISO, ensuring high precision and data integrity.

This includes home sample collection, comprehensive testing of 36 parameters, and digital report delivery through email and SMS. It offers great value for a preventive health screening focused on early cancer detection in women.

Ans.
Test reports are generally delivered within 24 to 48 hours after the sample has been collected. Thyrocare sends digital reports directly to your registered mobile number and email, allowing quick and easy access for review or consultation with your doctor

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the Women Cancer Screening Package Advanced?
It is a blood test package designed to screen for multiple cancer markers associated with common cancers in women.
Which cancer markers are included in this package?
The package includes CA-125, CA 15.3, B-HCG, CA 19.9, HE4, and the ROMA Index.
What types of cancers does this package help screen for?
It helps assess risks related to ovarian, breast, endocrine, and other gynecological cancers.
What is the role of the ROMA Index?
The ROMA Index helps predict the risk of ovarian cancer, especially in cases with ovarian or adrenal masses.
Is this package useful for early cancer detection?
Yes, early screening helps identify potential cancer-related risks at an early stage for timely intervention.
Is fasting required for this test?
Fasting is usually not required unless advised by a healthcare professional.
